# nn-diagram

> A diagram format written as JSX + Tailwind (*.diagram.jsx), meant to be read and written by people and LLMs. Files are parsed, never executed.

- [Format reference](https://yanexr.github.io/nn-diagram/reference.md): every element, prop, default and allowed value
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/yanexr/nn-diagram/blob/main/skills/nn-diagram/SKILL.md): how to write, check and render diagrams
- [CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/nn-diagram): `npx nn-diagram check|fmt|render|reference|skill`
